obligations.statement: The product must be attached to a wall.
derivation_premises: A product that is not attached to a wall cannot be wall-mounted.

obligations.statement: The product must dispense small items.
derivation_premises: If items are not dispensed, the product does not function as a dispenser.

obligations.statement: The product must hold approximately twenty items.
derivation_premises: The storage capacity is a property of the geometry and arrangement of the storage volume.

obligations.statement: Depressing the lever must dispense exactly one item per press.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that does not meter items will not consistently dispense exactly one.

obligations.statement: The product must allow refilling through a top opening while remaining attached to the wall.
derivation_premises: If the top opening is blocked or inaccessible, the user cannot refill without detaching the product.

obligations.statement: The product must dispense correctly even when nearly empty.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that relies on a minimum quantity of items may fail when the supply is low.

obligations.statement: The lever must be reachable and operable by the user.
derivation_premises: A lever that cannot be reached or operated cannot be pressed.

obligations.statement: The product must be mounted such that it can be refilled from the top without detachment.
derivation_premises: If the mounting interferes with the top opening, refill cannot occur while attached.

obligations.statement: The product must not jam when nearly empty.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that relies on gravity feed may jam if the remaining items do not align properly.

obligations.statement: The product must be able to contain and release items one at a time.
derivation_premises: A single item release requires a mechanism that can isolate one item from the bulk.

obligations.statement: The product must be able to be mounted to a wall and remain mounted during use.
derivation_premises: A dispenser that detaches during use cannot be wall-mounted.

obligations.statement: The product must be designed to dispense items without requiring the user to reach inside the storage volume.
derivation_premises: If the user must reach inside to retrieve an item, the mechanism does not dispense it.

obligations.statement: The product must be capable of being refilled without spilling or losing items.
derivation_premises: A top opening that is not clear may cause items to spill during refill.

obligations.statement: The product must be able to dispense items when the storage is nearly empty.
derivation_premises: A mechanism that cannot operate with a low fill level cannot meet the near-empty requirement.

load_cases.applied_to_role: the surface the product is mounted on

candidates.summary: A gravity-fed dispenser with a rotating metering wheel and a lever actuation.

predicates: Rigid body dynamics confirms the product remains attached under gravity and lever forces.
Swept interference confirms the top opening is clear during refill.
Mobility analysis confirms exactly one item is released per lever press even when nearly empty.

unresolved.decision: The exact capacity value within the range 'about twenty' is undefined.
unresolved.why_open: The capacity appears as a band and the requirement does not specify a target.

unresolved.decision: The lever placement, shape, and method of operation are unspecified.
unresolved.why_open: The lever is mentioned but its ergonomic design is not.

assumptions.statement: The wall is capable of supporting the dispenser and its contents.
assumptions.why: The product is wall-mounted, so the wall must resist the weight.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the wall is not strong enough or not vertical.

assumptions.statement: The small items are uniform and can be dispensed one at a time by a simple mechanism.
assumptions.why: The requirement assumes a single lever press releases one item.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the items are irregularly shaped or difficult to separate mechanically.
